plan.scope: A fixed-rung witness search in the unchanged 40-component normalized baseline-raw L-infinity geometry, baseline rung 4.
plan.warning: An unsuccessful local search is not evidence of nonexistence. Bisection lower endpoints are never certified lower bounds.
